Game Overview

Tomb Serpent is a puzzle game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Tomb Serpent doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Tomb Serpent?

Tomb Serpent is a free puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Tomb Serpent free to play?

Yes, Tomb Serpent is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
